name: M7.QuerySectors.all_sound
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F ∈ M7.QuerySectors.allSectors N → F.Monic ∧ F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N
queries: normalizedFactors Multiset powerset polynomial monic divisors
guidance: Use Multiset.mem_powerset iff multiset <=, product divisibility and normalizedFactors product. Over ZMod 2 every nonzero polynomial is monic (accepted SignatureTau.binary_monic); factor product is nonzero. M7.SignatureTau.modulus_monic N provides modulus nonzero. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.
